authority.note: locked in commissioned run 2026-08-07; design per Gary's brief (jungle / Founder Heaven allegory). Read back against declared invariants at lock time.

contract.map: A floating protopian island in open sky above the jungle. Underneath, a gentle teardrop of pale rock trailing thin skirts of mist. On top, terraced gardens stepping up from the rim, low cream buildings with warm windows, slender brass wind-spires, small orchards and pools. It floats free: no chains, no pillars, no engines. Two fixed camera angles: ESTABLISHING (from below, over the jungle canopy) and TERRACE (standing on a rim garden terrace looking along the edge, jungle far below like a green sea).
contract.blocking: From below, the island sits high in the frame with canopy or clearing in the lower third; it is never close enough to read individual doors. On the terrace, the rim rail and the drop beyond it carry the height; buildings stay low and behind, sky stays generous.
contract.dressing: Pale terraced stone, green gardens, low cream buildings with warm windows, brass wind-spires, soft banners without lettering, drifting small clouds. Futuristic reads as graceful and quiet, never chrome, never neon, never engines or thrusters.
contract.scale: The island reads about the size of a small hill town: whole gardens and rooftops are visible at once from below, and birds passing near it read as specks. From the terrace, the jungle below reads as a soft green sea with no individual trees.

houseRules.dressing: Pale stone terraces, gardens, orchards, pools, brass wind-spires, unlettered banners, small drifting clouds.

prose.rules: Protopian, not utopian kitsch: a real place people live and work, rendered warm and quiet. Its silhouette is owned by the establishing plate and must stay recognizable in every appearance: teardrop rock below, terraces and spires above. The silver elevator ribbons are too thin to see from the jungle floor; a scene that wants a ribbon meeting the island must ask for it by name.
